title: Halo
name: halo
description: Website and blogging platform with a rich editor, themes, plugins, comments and pages, run from a web console. This one runs on Postgres. Source: https://github.com/halo-dev/halo

env.name: HALO_DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy, or Halo can't reach its database.

env.name: HALO_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

env.name: HALO_TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: Like Europe/London. Post dates on the site use it.

note: Set the database password before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 32 makes a good one), since the stack won't start without it. Then open http://<your-host>:8091 (or whichever port you picked) from the address you'll actually use, since the setup page saves it as the site's address. That page creates the admin, and whoever reaches it first gets to, so do it straight away. The site and console are at / and /console. Posts and settings live in Postgres, in the postgres-data volume, and uploads, themes and plugins in halo-data. Docs: docs.halo.run
